items.guidance: Since only the raw pg driver is present, look for SQL files or a custom migrate script (for example under a migrations or db directory) and for schema-creation queries run at startup in src/index.ts or the worker source. Because the image runs compiled code from dist, any reported command must work against the built output in the Dockerfile image, not a TypeScript dev runner. Test only against a local or disposable PostgreSQL 16 instance.

Inspect src/index.ts and report which construct the detector likely flagged, quoting the relevant lines. Also report that the evidence and required outcome are too vague to act on without clarification.
